races.name: Twilight Racing On The Dee Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JIAIR MADRIK arrives here firmly on the up and this uncomplicated front runner representing a yard with an excellent record at this track may well add to his winning sequence. Country Park remains of interest as a chaser, with Lermoos Legend also considered back up in trip.

  1. JIAIR MADRIK (FR)
  2. COUNTRY PARK (IRE)
  3. LERMOOS LEGEND

races.name: John Hewitt Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN COOL has already had a fine season and having been found another small-field scenario, he may well shrug off a 5 lb rise. Krak should be a factor tackling a more suitable distance, while Roadlesstravelled certainly has the profile of one who will make a better chaser.

  1. CAPTAIN COOL (IRE)
  2. KRAK (FR)
  3. ROADLESSTRAVELLED (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There should be plenty more to come from HIDDEN FORTUNE, who was impressive at Fontwell when last seen in the spring so she is taken to see off Ride Like A Girl and Provision. An improved showing from Secret Beach would also come as no surprise.

  1. HIDDEN FORTUNE (IRE)
  2. RIDE LIKE A GIRL (FR)
  3. PROVISION

races.name: Wrexham Lager Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LUNAR ORBIT was no match for an improver on his first start for Dan Skelton at Newton Abbot recently, but it remains early days and he's worth another chance down in grade. Zamond arrives better than ever aged 10 and is likely to remain competitive, while Dream Jet has possibilities if building on a more encouraging run at Stratford a fortnight ago.

  1. LUNAR ORBIT (IRE)
  2. ZAMOND (FR)
  3. DREAM JET (IRE)

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SYOSSET remains winless following nine attempts over hurdles, but has done little wrong in handicaps this season and is taken to record a deserved first success in this sphere fitted with first-time cheekpieces. Front-runner Hello Sweety promises to be well suited by the sharp nature of Bangor providing the rain stays away and is feared most ahead of hat-trick seeker Roarin' Success.

  1. SYOSSET (IRE)
  2. HELLO SWEETY
  3. ROARIN' SUCCESS

races.name: Bangor-On-Dee Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SCOTTISH DANCER is worth another chance from his current mark based on his Flat exploits earlier in the year, so he earns the tentative vote. Seahouses is sure to be in the thick of the action if picking up where he left off in the spring, while Fine Print also enters calculations on the back of a good run at Ballinrobe.

  1. SCOTTISH DANCER (IRE)
  2. SEAHOUSES
  3. FINE PRINT (IRE)

races.name: Cleansing Service Group Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NAJIDI STORM created such a good impression on debut that he seems to have scared most of the original 6-day entries off. Wreck It Ronnie should follow him home.

  1. NAJIDI STORM
  2. WRECK IT RONNIE (FR)
  3. DREAM OF ALBION (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Peter Willett Future Stayers' Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
An interesting race. NOBLE TRAVELLER made a very good start to his career when just failing to get there in a valuable sales race in France last month and is narrowly preferred to Quicken Away, who shaped similarly well on debut when finding the line coming a couple of strides too soon at Newbury.

  1. NOBLE TRAVELLER
  2. QUICKEN AWAY (USA)
  3. ROYAL ACCLAMATION

races.name: Royal Sussex Regiment EBF Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SORRENGAIL sets the bar high on the form she showed when chasing home Evenfall in a similar race over 6f at Newbury last month and should take a bit of stopping if her stamina holds up in trip. Al Samsama didn't win a strong race by Newbury standards on debut but should have more to come, particularly at 7f, and she's feared most.

  1. SORRENGAIL
  2. AL SAMSAMA (IRE)
  3. SPIRIT TANGO (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap
races.verdict:
OVER SPICED is able to race off 2 lb lower than when best of the rest behind a progressive 3-y-o over C&D at the recent Celebration Mile meeting and should take a bit of stopping if in similar form. Spring Bloom has shown his recent good form over 6f at Newmarket but a near miss over C&D in the spring shows he's effective over shorter and he's second choice ahead of Jax Edge.

  1. OVER SPICED
  2. SPRING BLOOM
  3. JAX EDGE

races.name: Virgin Bet Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
MANXMAN looked as good as ever after a year off when fifth in a much better race than this at York 3 weeks ago, so this rates an excellent opportunity for him to resume winning ways off the same mark providing this relatively quick turnaround isn't an issue. The reliable Synergism is the obvious threat with his yard going great guns at present.

  1. MANXMAN (IRE)
  2. SYNERGISM (GER)
  3. FIREBLADE

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
BLUE WONDER has been given a break since her disappointing run at Leicester so she's taken to bounce back re-united with Oisin Murphy. Decalogue pulled a long way clear of the others when second off the same mark at Salisbury recently so looks a solid alternative.

  1. BLUE WONDER (IRE)
  2. DECALOGUE (USA)
  3. PLATINUM PRINCE

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
MARENGO STORM and Old Is Gold both shaped well in better handicaps than this last time with the former only narrowly preferred. Arry Up can also play a part if shrugging off his recent Kempton disappointment.

  1. MARENGO STORM
  2. OLD IS GOLD (IRE)
  3. ARRY UP

races.name: Racing To School Nursery
races.verdict:
The opener can go the way of AURA OF MELANIA, who was beaten only by one who has scored again since over this C&D on her latest outing. Cheeky Chesca finished a place behind the selection that day and could be the main danger this time around, ahead of Moriarty Moon.

  1. AURA OF MELANIA
  2. CHEEKY CHESCA (IRE)
  3. MORIARTY MOON

races.name: Racing TV Club Day Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good second at Ffos Las in July, QUEEN SANA was keeping on again when hampered at Lingfield last time so she's worth another chance as she returns to maiden company. She can open her account at the expense of Persian Gate, who could yet build on his debut promise, with Apex Star also in the mix.

  1. QUEEN SANA
  2. PERSIAN GATE (IRE)
  3. APEX STAR (IRE)

races.name: Fifth Regiment Royal Artillery Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
METHGAL has made a positive start for his current trainer, successful at Windsor last month and runner-up on his other 2 outings, so he is taken to resume winning ways. He can see off the challenge of Battenburg Belle, who boasts a strong record at this course, while Giant is another arriving on the back of a win last time out.

  1. METHGAL (IRE)
  2. BATTENBURG BELLE (IRE)
  3. GIANT

races.name: Fifth Regiment Royal Artillery Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HI LORD can have his run at Ayr a month ago ignored after meeting trouble leaving the stalls and, having dropped back down to his last winning mark, he is fancied to gain a second victory of the season. Last year's winner of this race Dream Deal isn't taken lightly, though, along with Ideal Guest who is the likely pace angle.

  1. HI LORD
  2. DREAM DEAL
  3. IDEAL GUEST (FR)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
TAAKLAM found a chunk of improvement fitted with first-time cheekpieces to get off the mark at Southwell 8 days ago and appealing the type to carry on winning now back on track, Harriet Bethell's 6-y-o can defy a 6-lb penalty. Kilmac Air shaped well on first outing for this yard at Carlisle recently, so she heads up the dangers returned to 7f, with last-time-out winner Lanarra rounding off the shortlist.

  1. TAAKLAM (IRE)
  2. KILMAC AIR (IRE)
  3. LANARRA (IRE)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN CESS has made a very good start for new connections and with this return to 7f in his favour, Declan Carroll's 4-y-o is fancied to double his tally. Filey Beach has largely held his form since landing back-to-back C&D handicaps in May, so he looks the main threat, with Electric Lightning and Showtime Mahomes taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. CAPTAIN CESS (IRE)
  2. FILEY BEACH (IRE)
  3. ELECTRIC LIGHTNING

races.name: RMG Proudly Supports Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy sprint in which it could pay to take a chance on KELDEO, who made her effort from further back than the trio that beat her at Wolverhampton recently and Ollie Pears' 5-y-o has since dipped below her last winning mark. Veteran Our Absent Friends loves it here and having quickly put a poor run behind him last time, he heads up the opposition. Wen Moon is also considered back from a 3-month break.

  1. KELDEO
  2. OUR ABSENT FRIENDS (IRE)
  3. WEN MOON (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again 30th September Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
ZIMMERMAN doubled his tally for the campaign with a gutsy success at Haydock on Saturday and able to race from the same mark here, Tim Easterby's 7-y-o is fancied to complete the hat-trick. The similarly thriving Star Start also won at that Merseyside track last week, so he can give the selection most to think about, with Fleur de Mer and Good Onya Mate taken to fight out third.

  1. ZIMMERMAN
  2. STAR START (IRE)
  3. FLEUR DE MER (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Ron Brooks Motor Group Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LIZZIE BENNET shaped well when splitting a couple of subsequent winners at Carlisle so is fancied to go one better. Newcomers From Afar and La Torre are a pair of well-bred fillies from top stables so they need keeping an eye on.

  1. LIZZIE BENNET
  2. FROM AFAR
  3. LA TORRE

races.name: British EBF 'Confined' Expotile Novice Stakes (Div 1)
races.verdict:
IWASJUSTSAYING looked potentially useful when scoring on his Doncaster debut and this Group-entered son of Ghaiyyath might be able to give the weight away. Astabuen is feared most on the back of a promising opening effort at Newmarket. United Authority should also build on his first run at Sandown, while Inkjet is a newcomer who makes paper appeal for a leading yard.

  1. IWASJUSTSAYING
  2. ASTABUEN (FR)
  3. UNITED AUTHORITY

races.name: British EBF 'Confined' Expotile Novice Stakes (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Possibly the weaker of the 2 divisions and MAGIC HARRY stands out among those with experience after his promising first run over 6f at Pontefract last month. Muhandes and Sterling Cooper are newcomers from top stables who could pose a threat if the betting speaks in their favour. Jinman should also step up on his Sandown debut.

  1. MAGIC HARRY (FR)
  2. MUHANDES (IRE)
  3. STERLING COOPER (IRE)

races.name: Mapei UK Nursery
races.verdict:
ARCTIC TSAR could flourish now stepping up in trip for his nursery debut and might be worth chancing to improve past recent Kempton runner-up Perfect Hope. Hemustbeanangel and Coul Blue also make the shortlist.

  1. ARCTIC TSAR (IRE)
  2. PERFECT HOPE
  3. HEMUSTBEANANGEL (IRE)

races.name: Dale Hall And Hickman Associates Handicap
races.verdict:
JOJO RABBIT is 2 lb below his last winning mark and has performed better than recent form figures suggest. He makes plenty of appeal. Toptime and Sergeant Mayer head the list of dangers.

  1. JOJO RABBIT
  2. TOPTIME
  3. SERGEANT MAYER (IRE)

races.name: Quality Freight Services Handicap
races.verdict:
HARRY'S HALO has dropped to a handy mark and arrives on the back of a good second in a stronger contest at Epsom. He gets the nod. Valentine Catcher and Eyes Front are also of interest.

  1. HARRY'S HALO (IRE)
  2. VALENTINE CATCHER
  3. EYES FRONT (IRE)

races.name: British EBF W.B Simpson & Sons (Midlands) Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
GASPACHO is in good hands and was very much a filly on the up last autumn. With her fitness unlikely to be an issue, she is taken to make a winning return. Dove Tale and Queen's Companion are feared most.

  1. GASPACHO
  2. DOVE TALE (GER)
  3. QUEEN'S COMPANION

races.name: Your Move Estate Agents Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
LITTLE TIGER has a good record here and caught the eye from an unpromising position at Lingfield last month. He could be the answer to the finale. Ricardo Phillips and Stipulation rate the principal dangers.

  1. LITTLE TIGER
  2. RICARDO PHILLIPS
  3. STIPULATION (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
Preference is for NOBLE EXHIBIT, who made a promising debut when third at the Curragh and can step forward from that effort as he goes up in trip. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate City of Gold with Aidan O'Brien bidding for a fifth consecutive win in this race, while Leadlight was only edged out last time and could be thereabouts once more.

  1. NOBLE EXHIBIT (IRE)
  2. CITY OF GOLD
  3. LEADLIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Donnellys Of Barna Rated Race
races.verdict:
LORD MASSUSUS often keeps better company so is taken to end his losing run. This does look competitive, though, with veteran Clear Quartz and unexposed 3-y-o Never Loose heading the dangers.

  1. LORD MASSUSUS (IRE)
  2. CLEAR QUARTZ (IRE)
  3. NEVER LOOSE (IRE)

races.name: James P. Cunningham Electrical Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots to consider but DOWN THE GLEN shaped well behind Jp's Express over C&D a month ago and may well reverse the form this time. Nazario looks dangerous up in trip, with Tharaka one to monitor closely in the market.

  1. DOWN THE GLEN (IRE)
  2. JP'S EXPRESS (IRE)
  3. NAZARIO (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
CHURCHILL BOND caught the eye from a hopeless position when fifth at Naas recently and gets the vote with futher progress looking assured. Autumn Gray was only narrowly behind the selection that day and is second choice ahead of Katiraya and Shenata.

  1. CHURCHILL BOND
  2. AUTUMN GRAY (IRE)
  3. KATIRAYA (IRE)

races.name: Racing In The City Of Tribes Handicap
races.verdict:
SAN AER looked unlucky not to give the quartet that finished ahead of him more to think about over C&D on his most recent outing, so he makes plenty of appeal in his bid to gain compensation from the same mark. Merisi Diamond and Loingseoir head the opposition.

  1. SAN AER (IRE)
  2. MERISI DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. LOINGSEOIR (IRE)

races.name: Ardilaun Hotel Irish EBF Oyster Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
Joseph O'Brien is responsible for nearly half of the field and may land this race for the third time since 2018 courtesy of BESET, who has a strong record fresh and is likely to have going to suit on her first start since the spring. Promising 3-y-o Chasing Paradise is another who hasn't been seen for a while, possibly to avoid summer going, and may provide the chief threat ahead of fellow lightly-raced sort Classiest. Snapretend, a stablemate of the selection, completes the shortlist.

  1. BESET
  2. CHASING PARADISE (IRE)
  3. CLASSIEST (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
PARTY DRESS has been shaping up well of late and with cheekpieces back on and in the hope she gets a good pace to aim at, she can get off the mark for the season. Faro Island is back in his grade so goes on the shortlist, with Shambata surely capable of better given her pedigree.

  1. PARTY DRESS (IRE)
  2. FARO ISLAND
  3. SHAMBATA (IRE)

races.name: Sean Cleary Memorial Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
PORTERS CORNER was only just edged out in a C&D maiden 6 weeks ago and she has every chance of going one better with further improvement likely. Zadawa should be bang there again, while useful hurdler Thisistheway is an intriguing contender.

  1. PORTERS CORNER (FR)
  2. ZADAWA (FR)
  3. THISISTHEWAY (IRE)

races.name: Prix De Nueil Sur Layon - Attele
Prix Des Nouveaux Partenaires Pmu - Prix De La Saone Handicap
Prix Jean Bart Listed Handicap Hurdle
